name: Epoch AI: AI models
access_method: Public CSV; methodology and field documentation linked from primary page
available_content: Model identities, dates, institutions, country, training compute, parameters, data size, estimated training cost and uncertainty labels.
historical_coverage: Models from 1950 onward; latest listed all-model CSV update 2026-10-05.
rights_notes: Primary page explicitly applies CC BY 4.0 to Epoch data; preserve source and author attribution.
next_action: Freeze a dated CSV snapshot, retain entry-level references and confidence labels, and resolve model-family/version identifiers.
caveats: Publisher is non-China but dataset includes China. Estimated compute is not measured compute; missing values and selection bias matter.

name: Epoch AI: machine-learning hardware
access_method: Public CSV and hardware documentation
available_content: Accelerator specifications, numeric precision performance, memory, release timing and selected release prices.
historical_coverage: Historical hardware releases; exact earliest observation not checked. Listed CSV update 2026-10-01.
rights_notes: Dataset page explicitly grants CC BY 4.0 reuse.
next_action: Snapshot CSV, distinguish dense/sparse and precision-specific FLOP measures, and separate list/release price from rental cost.
caveats: Specifications are theoretical peaks. Missing fields are common; no inference that all chips were deployed or available to a given lab.

name: Epoch AI: AI data centers
access_method: Public ZIP of CSV tables documented on source page
available_content: Facility capacity, construction timelines, chip quantities and related cooling/chip-type tables.
historical_coverage: Mostly facilities operational from 2024 onward plus selected earlier exceptions and under-construction projects; listed update 2026-10-05.
rights_notes: Dataset page explicitly grants CC BY 4.0 reuse.
next_action: Separate operational, under-construction and projected capacity; preserve observation date and underlying permits/satellite references.
caveats: US-heavy coverage is acknowledged by publisher. Announced/planned capacity is not available training compute; estimates can change.

name: METR: task-completion time horizons
access_method: Public repository with JSONL runs and reproducible analysis; headline page links raw data
available_content: Task-level scores, human-duration estimates, model aliases, weighting, p50/p80 horizons and bootstrap analysis.
historical_coverage: TH 1.0 covers models from 2019 through November 2025; TH 1.1 extends task suite; headline last updated May 8, 2026.
rights_notes: README references a LICENSE file but no effective data-license text was verified in this pass. Public availability does not establish redistribution permission.
next_action: Resolve data rights, pin repository commit, and ingest TH versions separately with scaffold, task and uncertainty metadata.
caveats: Software/ML/cyber tasks are not all work. Page warns measurements above 16 hours are unreliable; coverage is incomplete and evaluations lag releases.

name: LiveBench: judgments, answers and versioned benchmark data
access_method: Official GitHub links public Hugging Face datasets and JSONL download scripts
available_content: Versioned questions, model answers, objective judgments, category/task scores and release changelog.
historical_coverage: Public releases since 2024; complete result/benchmark-version coverage must be enumerated.
rights_notes: Repository has Apache 2.0 text inherited from FastChat; separate model-judgment data license was not displayed on the inspected dataset page. Audit per-artifact terms.
next_action: Verify judgment and question licenses, enumerate dataset revisions, then join model/release/configuration to scores.
caveats: Do not compare scores across changing question releases without adjustment. README notes that not all questions from the stated current release are public.

name: Stanford CRFM: HELM results and framework
access_method: Public framework, leaderboard and documentation; exact result export endpoint not verified
available_content: Scenario definitions, standardized metrics, leaderboard comparisons and per-prompt inspection capabilities.
historical_coverage: Historical suites since 2022; entered maintenance mode June 1, 2026.
rights_notes: Framework is Apache 2.0; this does not automatically license upstream datasets or every hosted output.
next_action: Treat as historical/reproducibility source; read maintenance policy and verify versioned result export plus per-scenario licenses.
caveats: No assumption of continued live model coverage. Suites and upstream benchmark rights differ.

name: SWE-bench: submission results and artifact registry
access_method: Public submission metadata/results repository; linked submitter repositories or legacy S3 artifacts
available_content: Submission dates, model/scaffold descriptions, result summaries, resolved-instance IDs and pointers to predictions/logs.
historical_coverage: Submissions since 2023; storage and submission policies changed during 2025–2026.
rights_notes: No blanket license for all submission artifacts was verified. Main benchmark code license is not sufficient for third-party repositories.
next_action: Pin entry commit, resolve each assets block, check artifact rights and join score with scaffold, budget, split and model checkpoint.
caveats: Current repository explicitly holds entries rather than all artifacts. Post-November-2025 eligibility changes and public benchmark contamination affect comparisons.

name: MLCommons: MLPerf training results
access_method: Public versioned result repositories; one concrete training release verified
available_content: Submitted system configurations, hardware/software stack, logs and training-to-target benchmark measurements.
historical_coverage: Versioned benchmark history; v5.1 repository verified as a concrete starting point, not claimed latest.
rights_notes: Inspected repository declares Apache 2.0; retain notices and check third-party components and MLPerf result-use rules.
next_action: Enumerate official release repositories and freeze one; normalize closed/open divisions and benchmark versions.
caveats: Training benchmark speed is not frontier capability or installed compute. Vendor submissions are selected and heavily optimized.

name: ARC Prize: ARC-AGI evaluations and public tasks
access_method: Public leaderboard and Apache-licensed public task repository
available_content: Cost/performance comparisons, test-policy context and ARC-AGI-2 public task JSON.
historical_coverage: ARC benchmark generations differ; verified public ARC-AGI-2 task release and current multi-generation leaderboard.
rights_notes: Apache 2.0 verified for ARC-AGI-2 repository; do not assume it also licenses every leaderboard submission or private evaluation set.
next_action: Freeze benchmark generation and public-task commit; separately obtain score export rights and mark preview/private-test results.
caveats: Task data is not a result time series. ARC-AGI-3 is interactive and must not be concatenated with earlier scores; costs and test-time budgets are essential.

name: AI Impacts: Expert Survey on Progress in AI
access_method: Official wiki links cleaned anonymized response sheet; survey papers and questionnaires
available_content: Respondent-level anonymized forecasts, question wording, framing, AI milestones and outcome/risk responses.
historical_coverage: 2016, 2022, 2023 surveys linked; homepage now also announces September 2026 paper on the 2024 survey. Only 2023 sheet inspected here.
rights_notes: Homepage applies CC0 to research pages, explicitly excluding blog posts. Scope of separately hosted response sheet requires confirmation.
next_action: Verify response-file rights, export approved anonymized fields, and preserve question wording, survey wave, framing and respondent population.
caveats: Non-response and sampling biases matter. HLMI, labor automation and extinction questions are different estimands; wording changed between waves.

name: Forecasting Research Institute: Existential Risk Persuasion Tournament
access_method: Public replication repository and report
available_content: Anonymized forecasts, forecaster-group metadata, question information, public-survey responses and R replication code.
historical_coverage: 2022 tournament; report published July 2023 and revised August 2023; replication release December 2023.
rights_notes: Repository lists MIT and a separate LICENSE file; complete effective data-license scope was not verified because license-file open failed.
next_action: Resolve data-license scope, pin replication branch/commit, and preserve question resolution criteria, tournament stages and group labels.
caveats: Exact timestamps were anonymized or replaced with ordering variables. Forecasts are beliefs, not empirical estimates of event frequencies; do not merge experts and superforecasters silently.

name: Metaculus: AI forecasts and question histories
access_method: Authenticated official API only; documentation reviewed, no account/token created
available_content: Question metadata and selected current aggregates under access tiers; broader historical or commercial access may need an agreement.
historical_coverage: Platform history exists, but accessible historical scope depends on permission/tier and was not verified.
rights_notes: Current docs require authentication, limit aggregate access, and require written permission for AI/ML development and commercial use. Terms updated September 21, 2026.
next_action: Define intended non-commercial/commercial use and request appropriate data permission before designing ingestion; retain as a gated candidate.
caveats: A public question page is not an open data license. No scraping fallback, and no assumption that a current API exposes full community-prediction histories.

name: Manifold: AI prediction-market data
access_method: Official API and documented bulk-download entry point; no download performed
available_content: Market definitions, resolution, prices/probabilities, trades and comments; historical dump links.
historical_coverage: Platform history from December 2021; free bulk dumps listed as last updated July 6, 2024.
rights_notes: Free dumps limited to personal/non-commercial use; commercial applications and AI/ML training licensing require separate consideration. API docs also prohibit non-API scraping.
next_action: Confirm intended-use rights and identify bounded AI question set; use official interfaces and preserve resolution/market-mechanism metadata.
caveats: Thin liquidity, ambiguous resolution and self-selection can dominate. Old free dumps are not a live forecast feed; avoid collecting personal profiles or unnecessary comments.

name: OpenAI: official system cards and deployment safety
access_method: Public HTML system cards, addenda and linked PDFs
available_content: Developer-reported capability/safety evaluations, safeguards, deployment decisions and versioned addenda.
historical_coverage: Archive includes multiple model generations; complete earliest coverage not enumerated in this pass.
rights_notes: Public reports do not by themselves provide a bulk-redistribution license; verify document-specific rights before republishing text/tables.
next_action: Build a document manifest with model/checkpoint/date, extraction locations and addendum relationships; resolve redistribution rights.
caveats: Developer-reported results are a distinct evidence class. Eval protocols and denominators change; third-party evaluations quoted inside a card should not be double counted.

name: Anthropic: official model system cards
access_method: Public dated card index, transparency summaries and linked PDFs
available_content: Capability/safety test results, risk assessments, deployment restrictions and model release information.
historical_coverage: Dated card list inspected from Claude 2 (July 2023) through 2026 models.
rights_notes: No general data-reuse license was verified for the cards; preserve citations and review document-specific rights.
next_action: Capture card/addendum versions and table-level provenance; separate self-reported and external-evaluator findings.
caveats: Transparency summaries can omit methodological detail. Different safeguards or access regimes can apply to related checkpoints; compare complete cards.

name: Google DeepMind: official model cards
access_method: Public model-card index with dated HTML/PDF links
available_content: Gemini, Gemma, generative media and robotics model descriptions, evaluation reports and limitations.
historical_coverage: Gemini 1.0 onward and other families; complete family/date coverage not enumerated.
rights_notes: No blanket reuse permission verified for all linked cards; different Google properties and model licenses must be distinguished.
next_action: Create family/checkpoint/card manifest; identify numeric evaluations and inspect per-document reuse notices.
caveats: A model-weight license is not automatically a report-data license. Capability, safety and modality coverage differ by card.

name: UK AI Security Institute: Frontier AI Trends and research evaluations
access_method: Public report and linked research; no universal raw-result export verified
available_content: Government evaluation trends in cyber, autonomy, safeguards, chemistry/biology and related risks.
historical_coverage: Evaluations described since November 2023; first trends report published December 2025.
rights_notes: No report-specific reuse license verified on the inspected page; do not infer it from government affiliation alone.
next_action: Catalog report figures with original evaluation dates and uncertainty; check underlying paper/data availability and license per release.
caveats: Report deliberately omits model/company labels and withholds some high-risk methods. Aggregates cannot be assigned to particular models; selected checkpoint dates differ from release dates.

name: AI Incident Database: incidents and taxonomy snapshots
institution_region: United States; Responsible AI Collaborative, global reports
access_method: Public dated MongoDB snapshots and weekly Excel-export links; binary export open failed in research tool
available_content: Incident entities, deduplication links, taxonomies, classifications and source-report references.
historical_coverage: Snapshot archive visible from March 2021 through October 2026; underlying incident dates can be older.
rights_notes: CC BY-SA applies to enumerated collections. Excludes prospective submissions, reports.text and content outside snapshots; full article text is not cleared.
next_action: Retrieve a permitted metadata snapshot after confirming artifact access, exclude unlicensed report text, and retain attribution/share-alike notices.
caveats: Reported incidents are not a population incidence rate. Duplicates, editorial selection, changing taxonomies and geographic/media coverage require modeling.

name: OECD.AI: AI Incidents and Hazards Monitor
access_method: Public search interface with Download results control; stable export endpoint not verified
available_content: Media-derived incident/hazard clusters, geography, dates, harm classifications and AI-generated summaries.
historical_coverage: Historical coverage varies by underlying news sources; exact earliest reliable coverage unknown.
rights_notes: OECD terms and third-party content rights apply; Event Registry media is not automatically licensed by OECD publication terms.
next_action: Read methodology and export conditions; preserve incident versus hazard labels and verify important events against original sources.
caveats: Automated media discourse monitor, not adjudicated causality. AI-generated classification can be wrong; counts combine hazards and incidents and overlap AIID.

name: Japan AISI: aisev safety evaluation environment
access_method: Public repository for evaluation tool and bundled evaluation dataset
available_content: Quantitative/qualitative safety evaluation presets, documentation and red-teaming support based on Japan AISI perspectives.
historical_coverage: Prototype described as of September 2025; commit/version history must be enumerated.
rights_notes: English README explicitly includes tools and bundled dataset under Apache License 2.0; audit any separately added datasets.
next_action: Inventory licensed preset datasets and Japanese labels, pin release, and map evaluation dimensions without running models.
caveats: Tool/presets are not a longitudinal result dataset or official certification. Do not treat future model runs as already collected results.

name: Apollo Research: scheming and external safety evaluations
access_method: Public research articles, reports and linked provider system cards
available_content: Controlled evaluations of scheming, deception, evaluation awareness, oversight and related model behavior.
historical_coverage: Public research and model-specific assessment entries at least from 2024 onward; complete archive not enumerated.
rights_notes: No comprehensive data license verified. Linked provider cards may duplicate reports and have different rights.
next_action: Identify study-specific artifact releases and rights, then extract outcomes with test conditions and baseline/checkpoint identifiers.
caveats: Strongly prompted stress tests do not measure spontaneous real-world prevalence. Maintain overlap links with provider cards to avoid duplicate evidence.

name: Eurostat: enterprise use of artificial intelligence (isoc_eb_ai)
access_method: Official dataset browser; structured export/API available in Eurostat, exact filtered API query not tested
available_content: Enterprise AI-use shares by country, size and activity, with survey metadata and quality flags.
historical_coverage: Article verifies 2024–2025 comparisons; precise full series start must be read from dataset.
rights_notes: Eurostat authorizes statistical data/metadata reuse with source attribution, subject to item-specific and third-party exceptions. Commercial reuse exceptions include data for countries outside EU/EFTA/accession-candidate coverage; check selected geography.
next_action: Select a reproducible dataset query and export dimensions/flags together; document enterprise universe and breaks.
caveats: Survey covers enterprises with 10+ employed persons in specified sectors. 2025 Netherlands break noted; incompatible with all-person generative-AI usage rates.

name: US Census Bureau: Business Trends and Outlook Survey AI
access_method: Official JS download portal; search-indexed documentation confirms national/sector/state XLSX; no file download verified
available_content: Biweekly current/expected AI-use estimates, size/industry/geography breakdowns, supplements and questionnaires.
historical_coverage: AI-use series from September 2023; later supplements; complete current download version must be checked.
rights_notes: Official citation guidance opened; specific reuse/public-domain policy for intended export not established in this pass.
next_action: Verify current XLSX/API retrieval, attach questionnaire version and uncertainty/suppression flags, and explicitly split November 2025 wording regimes.
caveats: November 2025 changed AI-use wording from producing goods/services to any business function. Not a continuous comparable level series without adjustment; excludes non-employer/farm universes as applicable.

name: UK ONS: Business Insights and Conditions Survey
access_method: Dated official XLSX download index; confidence-interval companion dataset
available_content: Wave-specific business AI-use questions and weighted estimates alongside business conditions; historical versions and uncertainty tables.
historical_coverage: BICS archive from 2020; AI questions occur in selected later waves and earliest comparable AI wave not yet verified.
rights_notes: Dataset page explicitly says OGL v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
next_action: Identify AI-question waves, pair estimates with confidence intervals and questionnaire versions, preserve corrected/superseded releases.
caveats: Voluntary survey and changing questions/sampling; not every fortnight contains an AI question. General BICS start date is not AI-series start date.

institution_region: Japan; Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications
access_method: Official ministry summary accessible; soumu.go.jp detailed data appendix blocked in research tool
available_content: Published cross-country generative-AI usage and Japan adoption comparisons; pointers to white-paper tables.

name: Korea MSIT/NIA: 2025 Survey on Internet Usage
institution_region: South Korea; Ministry of Science and ICT / National Information Society Agency
access_method: Official release with HWPX/ODT/ZIP attachments; exact download link not exposed by text tool

rights_notes: Release displays Korea Open Government License Type 1 attribution and an AI-use indicator; confirm each attached report inherits that notice.
next_action: Resolve official attachments and codebook; confirm target ages/universe, AI question wording, sampling weights and attachment rights.
caveats: Release headline is not respondent data. Korean-language review needed before cross-country comparison; avoid treating internet-use prevalence as AI adoption.

name: IndicGenBench: Indic-language generation benchmark
institution_region: India / United States; Google Research author release

available_content: Four multilingual generation task families across 29 Indic languages; paper and documented task/language structure.

caveats: Benchmark tasks are not result observations. Preserve evaluation holdouts and do not mix into training corpora; translated English-source tasks do not cover all local knowledge/safety.

name: AI Singapore: SEA-HELM
access_method: Official repository, per-dataset license manifest, Hugging Face migration and leaderboard

caveats: January/August 2026 aggregation changes affect comparability. Language list reflects documented regional scope, not equal coverage of every task in every language.

name: Brazil Cetic.br: ICT Enterprises survey

caveats: Formal enterprises with 10+ workers; do not infer all-economy or individual use. Survey years are not uniformly annual; preserve sampling errors.

name: IEA: Energy and AI
access_method: Public report PDF and online chapters; chart-specific downloadable data may require separate checks
available_content: Data-center electricity estimates, regional supply constraints and scenario projections for AI-related energy demand.

next_action: Catalog figure tables and units, distinguish observed/estimated/projected values, and verify any chart-data exports before extraction.
caveats: Energy use is not synonymous with training compute. Scenarios are not observations; data-center totals include non-AI workloads.

name: OECD.AI: Policy Navigator
access_method: Public policy database; stable bulk export/API not verified
available_content: National/international AI initiatives, strategies, policy descriptions, provenance and update timestamps.
historical_coverage: Living database; exact earliest policy/event coverage and revision history not verified.
rights_notes: OECD terms and third-party exceptions apply; confirm database export and redistribution permission specifically.

caveats: Policy entries describe initiatives, not enforcement or effectiveness. Official-contact updates vary across jurisdictions; archive entry revisions.

access_method: Official implementation page linking law, guidance and related instruments
available_content: AI Act implementation milestones, legal/policy links and general-purpose-AI governance context.

rights_notes: EU document-reuse conditions differ by item; authoritative legal text and third-party material need separate checks.
next_action: Follow each relevant link to authoritative EUR-Lex text; record instrument/article, adoption, entry into force, application dates and amendments.

name: Stanford HAI: AI Index public data
access_method: Official report links public-data Drive folder; folder contents not enumerated by text tool
available_content: Cross-domain research, capability, economy, responsible-AI, policy and public-opinion data; source-discovery and cross-check resource.

caveats: Mostly a synthesis rather than independent new observations; do not double count Epoch, AIID, benchmark or adoption figures. Chinese translation does not make this a China-origin source.

name: ITU: Facts and Figures connectivity indicators
access_method: Official report and linked chapters/PDF; DataHub access failed in research tool
available_content: Connectivity, access and digital-divide denominators useful for evaluating geographic AI-adoption coverage.
historical_coverage: 2025 report verified; indicator-specific longitudinal range not checked.
rights_notes: No specific reusable data-license statement verified in this pass; check report and DataHub terms separately.
next_action: Resolve licensed indicator exports and geography/year definitions; use only as coverage/context covariates.
caveats: Connectivity is not AI use, AI capability or existential risk. This source identifies missing-population context rather than filling absent AI observations.

name: Artificial Analysis: benchmark, price and speed data API
institution_region: United States / Australia; San Francisco headquarters and Melbourne presence
access_method: Documented authenticated data API; no account or API key created

caveats: Free technical access is not an open-data grant. Benchmark versions, provider settings, time-varying prices and rate limits affect comparability.

name: MIT AI Risk Repository: risk taxonomy and source mappings
access_method: Official taxonomy/database page links Google Sheets and OneDrive; linked Sheet open failed, so no resolved export URL recorded
available_content: Risk descriptions, source-paper identifiers, supporting page/quote references, causal taxonomy and domain taxonomy.

rights_notes: Official site explicitly licenses MIT AI Risk Initiative data CC BY 4.0. This does not confer rights to entire source papers or other third-party works.
next_action: Resolve the current downloadable table and pin version; preserve original taxonomy codes, source citations and any mapping transformations.
caveats: Taxonomy identifies kinds of risk, not likelihood estimates or an incidence denominator. Literature selection and classification choices can omit emerging or local risks.

name: FRI: Longitudinal Expert AI Panel (LEAP)
institution_region: United States; FRI, Stanford, Chicago Fed and Penn collaboration
access_method: Public wave reports and methodology; no structured response-data export or general license verified
available_content: Repeated and one-shot forecasts on capabilities, adoption, science, economics, catastrophic risk and safety policy; group summaries and question-specific rationales.

rights_notes: No general reuse license or respondent-level release verified on inspected report pages; public summaries do not authorize bulk transcript/rationale redistribution.

caveats: Wave labels are not release dates. Composition and response counts change; public respondents are US-focused. Conditional catastrophe forecasts must not be presented as unconditional p(doom).

name: OpenAlex: scholarly discovery metadata
institution_region: United States; OurResearch, global scholarly coverage
access_method: Official documentation for anonymous public snapshot catalog (JSONL/Parquet), API and manifests; no snapshot files collected
available_content: Works, authors, institutions, citations, identifiers, topics, dates and locations with per-copy license metadata for discovering primary papers.
historical_coverage: Broad historical literature; exact earliest relevant AI records unknown. Documentation specifies free quarterly snapshots and separate paid freshness services.
rights_notes: OpenAlex metadata is explicitly CC0. Linked PDFs/full text retain their own location-specific licenses; access fees/services are distinct from metadata rights.
next_action: Define bounded reproducible AI-risk literature queries, pin a snapshot/retrieval date, and deduplicate DOI/arXiv IDs before following primary documents.
caveats: Metadata catalog is not collected research evidence. Topic/author/institution inference and indexing coverage have errors; public-access flags do not imply unrestricted full-text reuse.

name: arXiv: scholarly metadata and versioned primary preprints
access_method: Documented Atom XML metadata API endpoint plus OAI-PMH/RSS; query/schema documentation read, no corpus ingestion
available_content: Preprint identifiers, versions, titles, author-provided abstracts, categories, dates, DOI/journal links and links to manuscripts.
historical_coverage: Versioned archive; exact earliest relevant AI-risk coverage not established in this pass.
rights_notes: Descriptive metadata is CC0. E-print redistribution requires the applicable author/publisher license; arXiv distribution permission alone does not grant public redistribution rights.
next_action: Create bounded category/keyword queries, retain version IDs and article license URLs, and respect official API rate limits.
caveats: Preprints are not necessarily peer reviewed. Metadata discovery is distinct from full-text acquisition and claim extraction; link to papers unless redistribution is licensed.
